profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer, Frontend-leaning

positions.title: Principal Front End Engineer
positions.locationName: Durham, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Digital Standards Squad, Workplace Investing

As a tech lead on the Digital Standards Squad, I provided coding standards, design patterns, and shareable libraries to all of Workplace Investing (WI) to enable developers and improve user experiences across NetBenefits and Plan Sponsor Workstation.

positions.title: FidelityMADE Software Engineer track
positions.description: Completed FidelityMADE, a highly selective professional development program that transitions existing Fidelity employees into Software Engineer roles.

positions.title: The Coding Boot Camp at UNC-Chapel Hill
positions.description: An intensive 24-week long boot camp dedicated to designing and building web applications. Curriculum covered JavaScript, jQuery, Node.js, Express, HTML5/CSS3, Bootstrap, Git, React.js, RESTful APIs, Firebase, MySQL, MongoDB, quality assurance testing, coding best practices, and more.
